text: Manufacturing operating system. Sounds official. It isn't.
MRP, ERP and MES have settled meanings. MOS has no standard.
Vendors use it for four different things.
One: a way of managing. Meetings, standards and measures. Not software.
Two: a layer that connects the ERP and MES you already run.
Three: a newer kind of MES, close to the machines.
Four: one system for a small shop. Stock, jobs, costs and quality.
10 to 50 people on spreadsheets? You usually need number four.
So ask every vendor: which one do you mean? Read the full guide at zudoworks.com.
